text:
Marie (Partnerships): Hey team — ZephyrAI wants to list their 13B model on the Redwood marketplace and offer an SI bundle with EdgeBox HW. We need to confirm licensing/export clauses, geoblocking, KMS + hosting options, and announcement embargo timing. TL;DR: they prefer hosted API but want an option for SIs to host download bundles for on-prem customers.
Anil (Legal): @Marie can you paste the draft redistribution clause? Need to check export control flags for model weights. If it's just hosted inference that's easier. :thinking: 
Marie (Partnerships): pasted below — it's the supplier's proposed snippet:
`Redistribution: Provider grants non-exclusive rights to distribute model weights to certified SIs under restricted use, subject to export compliance and geoblocking.`
Anil (Legal): That's helpful — add explicit export-license responsibility line: `Provider is responsible for export classification and obtaining any required licenses.` Otherwise we need indemnity. Will circle back with redlines by EOD.
Laura (Product): From product side — prefer model stay hosted by Redwood for initial launch so we can guarantee latency SLAs. If SI wants a download SKU, let's gate it to Tier 2 customers after 90 days.
Kyle (Solutions): For SI integration we need clear manifest & sample inference wrapper. Recommend we ask for a `packaging-manifest.json` with fields: model_name, version, checksum, quantization, supported_hw (EdgeBox v2), license_file, attestations.
Samir (Platform): To support hosted + SI bundle, we'll need: (1) KMS integration for customer keys, (2) signed checksum verification in install script, (3) variant mapping for quantized weights. I'll prototype a validation script this week.
Ellen (Marketing): Announcement cadence: propose internal partner preview on Mon 9/14, partner press embargo until Wed 9/23. Need final logo assets + product one-pager by 9/10. :calendar: 
Marie (Partnerships): Action items summarized:
- @Anil: legal redlines and export clause by EOD today
- @Samir: validation script + packaging spec draft by Thu
- @Kyle: SI onboarding checklist + training slides
- @Ellen: draft announcement timeline & asset list
- @Laura: gating plan for download SKU (90d) or hold-off
I'll update ZephyrAI with this plan after legal signs off. Thoughts?
Anil (Legal): fine — if Zephyr insists on redistribution right with no export responsibility, we push back. Also add GDPR/data-provenance warranty if model trained on scraped data. 
Kyle (Solutions): noted. I'll draft the `packaging-manifest.json` example:
```json
{
  "model": "zephyr-13b",
  "version": "v1.0",
  "sha256": "<checksum>",
  "quantized": "int8",
  "hw_compat": ["edgebox-v2"],
  "license": "restricted-si"
}
```
Marie (Partnerships): Perfect. I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri to finalize. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: New repo created: partners/zephyrai-onboard (private) — CI pipeline initialized.
